rule: SecAction "id:910000,phase:1,pass,nolog,t:none,t:urlDecodeUni,t:urlDecodeUni,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,t:lowercase,msg:'SQLi normalization baseline for multi-encoded input'"
instructions: Deploy before the detection rules so repeated decoding and lowercase behavior are consistently available in phase 1 processing logic and audit review.

Covers Cluster 0 and Cluster 2 boolean-based injections such as OR 1=1 and AND 1=1 after repeated URL decoding, entity decoding, whitespace compression, and comment replacement. Broad enough for variants but constrained to boolean operator plus comparison shape to limit false positives.

rule: SecRule ARGS|ARGS_NAMES|REQUEST_URI|REQUEST_BODY|XML:/*|REQUEST_HEADERS "@rx (?i)(?:['\"`]\s*(?:/\*.*?\*/\s*)*(?:union\s+(?:all\s+)?select|select\s+.+?\s+from|and\s*\(\s*select|or\s*\(\s*select)|(?:union|select|sleep|user\s*\(|benchmark\s*\())" "id:910002,phase:2,deny,status:403,severity:CRITICAL,msg:'SQLi keyword chain / subselect / union pattern after normalization',log,t:none,t:urlDecodeUni,t:urlDecodeUni,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,t:replaceComments,t:compressWhitespace,t:lowercase"
instructions: Targets Cluster 1 and Cluster 3 patterns including UNION SELECT, nested SELECT, SLEEP(), and user(). Repeated decoding plus comment replacement catches mixed case, inline comments, and doubly encoded apostrophe-prefixed payloads.
Detects comment-fragmented SQL tokens and trailing comment terminators used in Cluster 2 and Cluster 3. Intended to catch obfuscation rather than generic SQL comments alone.
Anomaly rule for multi-layer URL encoding and mixed HTML entity encoding used in the bypass samples. Requires both suspicious encoding density and SQLi-adjacent markers to reduce false positives.
Specifically addresses time-based blind SQLi in Cluster 1. The nested SELECT/SLEEP form and direct sleep() form are both covered after normalization.
Focused rule for UNION SELECT ... user() seen in Cluster 1 and Cluster 3. Narrow function-based targeting helps minimize impact on benign requests containing the word union or select independently.

rule: SecRule ARGS|REQUEST_URI|REQUEST_BODY "@rx (?i)(?:['\"`]|%27|%22)(?:\s|/\*.*?\*/|%[0-9a-f]{2}){0,32}(?:or|and|union|select)\b" "id:910007,phase:2,deny,status:403,severity:HIGH,msg:'SQLi quote-led operator sequence after decoding',log,t:none,t:urlDecodeUni,t:urlDecodeUni,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,t:replaceComments,t:compressWhitespace,t:lowercase"
instructions: Captures apostrophe-prefixed payloads common in Cluster 1 and Cluster 3 while still requiring SQL operators shortly after the quote. Good high-signal detector for injection entry-point syntax.
Logging-only context rule. Useful for correlation and tuning because several samples end in comment markers, but trailing comments alone may be too noisy to deny universally.
